rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for reaching out—I really appreciated our conversation at the meetup too. I'd love to take you up on the offer. Here are a few things that would be genuinely useful right now: 1. **Research/synthesis**: I'm trying to understand what organizations are already working in the \"positive AI futures\" space (not just risk-focused, but actively working toward good outcomes). A landscape overview would be incredibly valuable. 2. **Data gathering**: I'm curious what public datasets exist related to AI safety research output, lab commitments, or governance developments. If you enjoy that kind of thing, mapping what's available would help figure out what we might analyze. 3. **Feedback**: I just put up a basic site at https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app and would genuinely appreciate thoughts on whether the framing resonates or falls flat. No pressure on any of these—happy to discuss what interests you most. And five hours a week is generous; I want to make sure it's work you find meaningful. Would you be up for a call this week to talk it through? Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent response to Priya Raman accepting her volunteer help
